organization.title: Organization
organization.name: Organization name
organization.currencyHint: Used for new jobs and dashboard totals. Amounts are never converted.
organization.adminOnly: Only organization admins can change these settings.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.aiDescription: Reads job postings (link, PDF, scanned files) and resumes, and adds semantic skill matching. Without it, extraction and scoring are rule-based.
integrations.emailDescription: Without it, notifications are in-app only.
integrations.paymentsDescription: Settlement is recorded through a verified manual ledger. No funds move through MissionHub.
integrations.residency: Data residency: configure your Supabase project in a Canadian region (ca-central-1). Subprocessors such as AI or email vendors may process data outside Canada.

team.inviteDescription: Candidates and jobs belong to the organization; each record keeps a responsible owner. Recruiters can manage records and referrals; managers also handle privacy requests and audit; admins manage the team.

privacy.logDescription: Candidates aren't users, so requests arrive by email or phone. Log them here to track deadlines. Draft process — legal review required.

form.candidateIdHint: Copy from the candidate page URL.

actions.startDescription: Record that the request is being handled.
actions.completeDescription: Describe what was done (e.g. data exported and sent, record anonymized).

validation.contact: How can we reach the requester?

messages.logged: Request logged. Respond within the statutory timeline (PIPEDA: generally 30 days).

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.languageHint: Used across MissionHub on this browser.
preferences.themeHint: Choose light, dark, or follow your device.
preferences.description: Your language and appearance on this browser. They don't affect your teammates.
